name: Kyonyuu Gyaru MC Kousai "Konna Oji-san Chi*po ni Sakaraenai Nante...... Maji Arienai!"
original_name: 巨乳ギャルＭＣ交際「こんなオジサンチ○ポに逆らえないなんて……マジありえないっ！」
source: Main character is loner corporate slave who is always bullied at work by boss and colleagues due to his clumsiness and inability to read the mood. After getting tricked by four high school girls in compensated dating, he got his hands on some hypnosis app called MC through a mysterious friend online and decides to use it to take revenge on them.
translation: 主人公是孤独的公司社畜，总因笨拙、不会察言观色而遭到上司和同事欺负。被四名高中女生用援助交际欺骗后，他通过网上一位神秘网友得到了一款名为MC的催眠应用，决定用它向她们复仇。
